model.immutable_service_version: unknown; record returned model and request time

e0.purpose: implementation and accounting repair before live comparison

e1.source: S3 r3 immutable checkpoints are used as historical search states; continuation data blocks are new 44-47
e1.checkpoint_selection: one fixed checkpoint per S3 block-arm pair, selected by source step before continuation outcomes are inspected
e1.primary_endpoint: paired continuation loss improvement over checkpoint incumbent
e1.cost_endpoint: actual model tokens and complete proposal cost
e1.selection_rule: checkpoint identities and parent choices are frozen before any E1 continuation response is read

e2.purpose: 2x2 attribution of scheduling priority and eviction protection

generation.invalid_or_truncated_slot: consume the slot and record the failure
generation.provider_failure: stop only the affected job; retain partial output; no automatic retry

isolation.test_access: only after all live search jobs in the stage are terminal
isolation.test_selection: validation-selected single program plus shared seed comparator
isolation.independent_unit: data block; seed is a within-block repeat
isolation.bootstrap: descriptive block bootstrap only; no confirmatory p-values

decision_rules.component_retention: retain, simplify, or delete only from preregistered endpoint and evidence; inconclusive remains evidence_insufficient

protocol.claims: E0-E2 are implementation, mechanism, and component-screening evidence. They do not establish universal superiority, cross-task transfer, or a final doctoral-method claim.

status_note: offline checkpoint preparation only; no E1 continuation has run
